reviews.title: Easy assemble and Impressive First Impressions!
reviews.comment: This chair is a fantastic upgrade for my home office! It was easy to assemble, and the instruction were clear. The seat is highly comfortable, offering great support, and the sleek design looks wonderful in my workspace.  The wheels roll very smoothly, making it effortless to move around. I especially like the lumbar support, which helps protect my lower back during long hours of sitting. The chair feels solid, durable, and is a great value for the price!
reviews.author: BS

reviews.title: Budget chair surpasses my expectations!
reviews.comment:
At first, I had doubts regarding the chair’s comfort and functionality because of its price, but I am truly amazed! The craftsmanship is superb, and putting it together was simple.
This chair comes with adjustable armrests and a highly comfortable seat that gives outstanding lumbar support. Additionally, the blue shade is a striking and lively color.
The support from the company was outstanding too; they answered my question in no time. I feel really fortunate to have selected this chair rather than shelling out extra money for a luxury brand!
reviews.author: Irwin Spector

reviews.title: Great Value for a Comfortable Home Office Chair
reviews.comment:
I’ve been using this chair for a couple of days now, and honestly, it’s been a solid upgrade from my old one. I work from home most days, so comfort matters a lot—and this chair delivers better than I expected for the price.
The first thing I noticed was the lumbar support. It’s actually adjustable and makes a noticeable difference, especially if you tend to sit for long stretches. My lower back used to get sore after a few hours, but that hasn’t really been an issue since switching to this chair. The mesh back is also a nice touch—it keeps things breathable, which I didn’t think I’d care about until I had it.
Assembly was pretty straightforward. Took me maybe 20–25 minutes without any frustration. Everything lined up well, and the instructions were clear enough.
In terms of comfort, the seat is firm but not hard. It doesn’t feel like one of those super plush chairs, but I actually prefer that because it feels more supportive over time. The reclining feature is smooth, and I like that you can lean back a bit when you need a break.
Overall, I’d say this is a great value for a home office setup. If you want something ergonomic and comfortable without spending a fortune, this chair is definitely worth considering.
reviews.author: EJ

reviews.title: Excellent Office Chair
reviews.comment: I just received my TRALT Office Chair. First of all, I was impressed with the packaging of this item. When I opened the box each piece of the chair was wrapped in plastic or bubble wrap.  Everything in the box arrived safely and without damage. Secondly, the instructions to assemble the chair were very each to follow.  I was impressed with the Allen wrench which had a handle attached to it. This made screwing in the screws very easy. I was able to assemble the chair without any difficulty. Lastly, the look of the chair and the comfort is exceptional. I ordered the black/white chair which looks amazing. The comfort of the chair is really excellent.  My back is supported by the lumbar seat and having the armrests being able to go up when not needed is wonderful. The quality of the chair is definitely worth the price.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Sturdy and comfortable
reviews.comment: This chair is very sturdy and easy to assemble. I really like the lumbar support, which my previous chairs did not have. The chair is relatively heavy, due to the heavy duty parts. It is a tiny bit wobbly when raised to full height but not enough to be bothersome. The seat is wider than other chairs I have had. I think it would be hard to find a better one for $100.
reviews.author: Mark Watkins
